late_flip_final_vs_tuesday_side_2026_w2_.classification_evidence: Final side 13-10 against Tuesday side 10-13; 23 looks in one family of two contrasts; interval far below resolving a small effect
late_flip_final_vs_tuesday_side_2026_w2_.description: Accuracy of the final published card side minus the Tuesday card side over the 23 games whose side changed between Tuesday and the pool lock, Weeks 2-8 2026, graded at the pool line
late_flip_final_vs_tuesday_side_2026_w2_.plain_summary: Games where the pick changed after Tuesday: the later pick went 13-10 and the Tuesday pick went 10-13, so the changes helped slightly but cannot be told from luck.

late_flip_move_driven_vs_other_final_acc.plain_summary: Late pick changes caused by the line-movement term went 7-4; changes caused by injury and lineup information went 2-3. The gap is far too small a sample to separate from luck.
